meta.name: POSAPP
meta.description: Restaurant POS: Vue 3 SPA served by Express, MySQL via mysql2, Socket.IO realtime, and a Windows print spooler service on each printer machine. Packaged for offline install on clean Windows machines.
meta.purpose: Machine-readable architecture graph. Read this before tracing a flow or proposing a change, instead of re-exploring the tree. Every node.file and step.file was opened and verified, not inferred.
conventions: Event timestamps (created_at, opened_at, invoice_issued_at) are UTC; raw SQL strings must use parseBackendTimestamp. Scheduled delivery_date is a business-local DATETIME returned as a string by databasePoolOptions; never decode it as an event timestamp. Frontends load /api/config/business before mounting; queued print payloads freeze business_config and the spooler uses businessTime.js rather than its machine clock. Calendar issue/audit date filters use local midnight converted to UTC; operational reports use the configured business-day cutoff.
Admin product/category forms always send GROSS (tax-inclusive) price; the API strips tax via grossToNet() before writing the NET price column; never write data.price straight to the products table.

Any catalog-affecting write must call the trio: invalidateCatalogCache()/invalidateDashboardCache(), triggerStaticMenuGeneration(), and emit 'inventory_changed' or 'settings_changed' on the staff socket room; skipping one leaves POS terminals stale.

Recipe ledger ingredient writes drop the catalog cache after commit (linked products' availability moves) but never regenerate the static menu. They emit ingredients_changed with { ingredientIds } and announce the affected products through StockEventScope.announceStockChanged, which emits nothing when no product is linked.

A product has one main barcode in products.barcode and up to 20 extra barcodes in product_barcodes; every code is unique across both (the two unique indexes keep each table unique, productBarcodes.assertFree keeps them distinct from each other). Every exact barcode match is main OR extra, written as p.id IN (OWNER_IDS_SQL) from services/productBarcodes.js, two uncorrelated scalar subqueries on the unique keys; never p.barcode = ? OR a subquery, and never IN (SELECT ... UNION ALL SELECT ...), which plans as a per-row dependent subquery that walks the products index. Extras never ship in the POS catalog payload.

Ordinary product/category removal uses is_active = 0. Catalog replacement in admin/import.js is the explicit hard-delete exception; stock-authority activation must block that replacement or supply a complete history-preserving adapter.
Modifier group/option ids are minted server-side by modifierDefs.normalizeModifierDefinition() and must be round-tripped by the client on edit, or existing ids get silently reassigned.
user_number (login PIN) must always be handled as a string; never parseInt() it, or leading zeros are stripped and the account can no longer log in.
Bundles are exactly one level deep: product_bundle_items enforces this at write time (bundle-items.js) and bundleIntegrity.js re-asserts it against corrupt held/order data at checkout time.
user_number is the sole login credential -- never add a password field without also re-checking every place that treats user_number as low-sensitivity.
admin_pin is always compared via verifyPin (bcrypt-first, SHA-256-legacy-fallback) -- never compare admin_pin with === or hashToken.
Session tokens are hashed with SHA-256 (hashToken) before DB storage/lookup; admin_pin is hashed with bcrypt (hashPin) -- the two are not interchangeable.
requireAuth only reads the pos_token httpOnly cookie -- never accept a bearer/Authorization header for staff session auth.

Any code path that mutates durable auth_sessions, registered-browser credentials, or a user's permissions must also evict the matching token cache (invalidateCredentialSessions/invalidateUserSessions) or stale authority can survive the 30-minute idle window.
admin/programmer roles bypass PermissionService.userHas entirely (isAdminRole short-circuit) -- granting/revoking rows in user_permissions has no effect on those two roles.

Manager approval returns only manager identity and supported approved actions. Checkout reuses the proof inside one invocation and checks each field separately; it never changes the employee role, grants or section scope.
Authenticated manager-override attempts use separate actor/surface namespaces and remain independent of public login lockout; network address is audit metadata, not another override budget.
Never bypass validateRequiredSchema when adding a migration, bump MIGRATION_NAME and MIGRATION_CHECKSUM in schemaValidation.js and mirror the same ledger insert in bootstrap-database.js.
All installer secrets (root, app, and maintenance passwords, blowfish secret, spooler key) come from installer-config.js generate-secrets, never hardcoded.
Durable state (config, database, uploads, backups, logs, sessions) lives only under ProgramData POSApp or ProgramData POS-Spooler; Program Files POSApp is treated as fully disposable by uninstall.
Any new vendor binary must be added to deployment/vendor-lock.json with a verified SHA-256 before build-installers.ps1 will stage it.
Repair-mode installer code paths must never regenerate secrets already present in pos.env or backup.env.
Desktop shortcuts and install.json are written by Install-PosServer.ps1, not the Inno Setup wizard, so repair installs always reflect the real persisted ports.
Boot recovery is owned by Windows service failure actions plus the two installer-created delayed startup tasks; never rerun the full installer or database bootstrap automatically at boot.

print_queue is durable unresolved-delivery state, not permanent print history: bounded maintenance first acknowledges dead-letter ancestors already fulfilled by a successful retained reprint, then hard-deletes only acknowledged rows created and settled before the current business day; failed and nonterminal work survives.

While a print_queue row exists, idempotency is enforced by the idempotency_key UNIQUE constraint plus ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=LAST_INSERT_ID(id) in enqueuePrintJobs; successful-row purge intentionally expires that print-layer deduplication key, and producers never insert rows outside buildPrintJobRecord.

A spooler can only claim jobs for printers whose printers.spooler_id column matches its authenticated station; the route first rejects a submitted configured-station mismatch and the SQL join in runAgentSync remains the claim authority.

Kitchen work is marked printing at the duplicate-safe transport boundary: immediately before TCP socket.write or before invoking the Windows copy process; validation, rendering and TCP-connect failures remain safe to retry.

All user-influenced text bound for a receipt or kitchen ticket must go through sanitizePrintString before it reaches print_queue payload, to strip ESC/GS control bytes that could inject ESC/POS commands.
Paid receipts always rebuild their print payload from the orders and order_items tables in POST /api/print; client-submitted item/price fields are never trusted for a paid invoice.
Print delivery is enqueue then authenticated HTTP sync; do not add a parallel claim or settle state machine beside runAgentSync.

Routable kitchen work for a new checkout or table save is inserted into print_queue in the same transaction as the order mutation; the browser never owns automatic kitchen admission, and a queue insert failure rolls back the order mutation.

Updated spooler agents reserve five of their existing 50 durable local slots for kitchen work; the server claims kitchen rows before ordinary work and uses the additive kitchen_capacity field while older agents remain compatible through capacity.

Current and updated agents share protocol_version 2 and POST /api/spooler/v2/sync; wait_ms is an optional capability, requires no installer/runtime dependency transition, and old agents retain immediate responses.
The in-process spooler wake is advisory and payload-free: durable database state plus bounded authenticated sync cadence recovers missed or cross-process signals.
Graceful server shutdown closes the spooler wake hub before Socket.IO and HTTP so held sync responses release without extending the 15-second drain.
Never trust client cart item.price for a non-frozen line: applyDatabasePrices re-derives it unless the employee canPriceOverride or this checkout supplies an explicit priceOverrideApproved option.

Priced note-category selections carry noteProductId; their display text and displayed price are never money authority. Catalog search classifies each result from its returned category_is_notes metadata, never from the active navigation category.

checkoutAttemptCache keeps a separate pos_pending_checkout request until an authoritative success or an initial definitive rejection; close/reload and draft resets do not rotate a sent key. Draft IDs prevent recovery from clearing a newer order. Manager PINs are excluded from the saved frozen payload.
useCart() is a logic-free re-export facade by explicit code comment — new branching belongs in orderSessionStore.js or orderUiStore.js, not there.

quick_numpad_mode is durable settings authority, but quickTargetAmount is transient one-shot UI intent and must never be serialized into localStorage, sessionStorage, cart, held-order, table, or checkout payloads.

The POS boot shell is inline and remains visible until its lazy register/table route resolves. Rare POS dialogs load only while open; checkout/modifier/note chunks preload during idle. Arabic translations are a separate chunk prepared before Arabic UI mount or print, while English startup must not fetch that catalog. A failed deployment chunk never replaces an already-mounted order screen; only a cold boot may perform one bounded reload.
Money is validated in integer cents at the split-payment and split-check boundaries (SplitMoneyAllocator.moneyToCents), never compared as floats.
A finalized (paid) invoice is immutable: only payment_method==='unpaid_table' orders may be re-submitted through edit_invoice_id, checked under a row lock even for admins.
invoice_number is assigned exactly once, only for paid payment methods, via ensurePaidInvoiceNumber — never derive it from order_id or any client field.
order_id (daily display number) always comes from reserveDailyOrderId's write-based counter — never SELECT MAX(order_id)+1, which is snapshot-stale under REPEATABLE READ.
All business-day range queries must go through getBusinessDateRange/getBusinessDayRange in backend/utils/businessDate.js, never DATE(created_at) directly, or the 06:00 boundary silently breaks.

Refund attribution differs by report: dailyRefundReportBuilder attributes by refund event date (refunds.created_at); productSalesMetrics/dashboard attribute refunds to the refunds own business_date, both distinct from the original sales date.
Any new report that counts sold units must SUM(oi.quantity) directly and must not derive quantity from money fields, keeping unit counts unaffected by discounts (see productSalesMetrics.js).

JoFotara submissions must always go through prepareSalesDocument/prepareCreditNote status machine (pending/submitting/accepted/rejected/unknown); never update jofotara_documents.status directly from a route.

Every table-group mutation must lock via TableSettlementContext.lockTableSession, or the equivalent FOR UPDATE ORDER BY id pattern in tableRelationships.js, never a single-row SELECT FOR UPDATE, or a sibling joined table can be silently left in a mismatched state.

Bill mutations (void, merge, transfer, split-create) must call assertNoActiveSplitChecks before touching the order. Seating join/disjoin touches only seating_parent_id and permits existing split checks without changing their bill identity, contents or allocations.

restaurant_tables.seating_parent_id is physical seating membership. parent_table_id retains legacy shared-bill aliases and current_order_id identifies their issued bill. New joins never propagate current_order_id/status or change orders.table_id. Save, split, print, transfer, void and checkout continue to operate on the bill and its aliases, independently of neighboring seating bills.

Progressive split editing rewrites only the currently unpaid held_orders siblings under the same table/group lock; split_revision rejects stale terminals, paid children are immutable, and item micro-quantities plus every split_money_cents component must conserve exactly.

Split-check seat items must be re-priced from the locked parent order_items by order_item_id, never trusted from the client cart payload, or a seat can be underpriced (see splitChecks.js line 421 pinning logic).
A table order's order_id/invoice display number is only assigned at checkout, never at table_order save, so voiding an unpaid table never gaps the daily invoice sequence.

Tax exemption is a frozen per-order fact: a literal boolean true requires pos.tax_exempt (or admin authority), orders.tax_exempt_at_sale records the decision, and order_items.price_before_tax_exemption retains each taxable inclusive line's source price for table reloads, context changes, refunds, receipts and JoFotara.
Every table mutation that changes a table row must call broadcastTableUpdate(s) from TableRealtime.js after commit so all terminals in the staff room converge on the same floor-plan state.

Platform provider remittances are append-only settlement facts owned by PlatformRemittanceService: signed invoice allocations, typed adjustments, reversals, cents math, balance tokens and order-first locking must never be reimplemented in routes, reports or the admin page.

Table staff access reuses PermissionService.getTableSectionIds and users.table_access_scope (all/selected/none). Missing or unknown scope fails closed; selected reads allowed_sections. Admin/programmer bypass and fixed call-center denial remain role rules. Grants, ownership and persisted-state checks stay separate.

TableSettlementContext.lockTableSession requires the original user and checks every locked group section before loading money. Join/disjoin manager PINs authorize only that action and never replace the actor role, grants or assigned sections. F4 committed action receipts remain readable/replayable by their original actor with the current action grant after later table/scope changes.

TableRealtime content uses server-assigned table-access rooms, never the client-selected section room or the broad staff room. Verified session scope determines membership; user security edits already revoke sessions and disconnect their sockets. QR guest tokens are omitted from realtime table snapshots.
invariants: The store-icon filename extension is derived ONLY from sniffed magic bytes (png/jpg/ico/webp), never from the client-supplied filename or Content-Type; this is what closed the prior Apache-served PHP/SVG RCE.
Brand icon uploads are held in multer memoryStorage and validated (size <= 1MB, magic-byte sniff) before any bytes are written to the uploads/ directory.

A price override in product_price_overrides is only valid while its product's category still resolves to that exact price_list_root_id; category-price-lists PUT re-verifies this under FOR UPDATE before writing.

products.price_override_locked is catalog presentation state: it disables the POS Price key for the selected cart line, and catalog refresh rehydrates the flag on restored or open carts without changing checkout pricing authority.
A bundle can never contain another bundle (is_bundle=1 sub-item is rejected) and can never contain itself.

settings table values are looked up by setting_key with no server-side cache layer of their own; settingsHelper.getSettings() always hits MySQL. The catalog/dashboard caches in config/cache.js are the only cached layer.
A user row with is_active=0 must never authenticate -- both login and durable auth_sessions lookup filter on is_active=1.

While device access is enforced, a non-programmer with any eligible registered browser must use a bound session; a user with no eligible browser remains PIN-only, and the hidden programmer always remains PIN-only.
Registered-browser challenges and enrollment ceremonies are durable, short-lived, flow-bound, exact-origin-bound, row-locked, and one-use; failed replacement rolls back the old credential state.
Credential revocation updates durable rows first, then evicts the matching HTTP cache and disconnects the exact Socket.IO credential/session room.

PIN login during enforced device access is allowed only when that user has no eligible registered browser; first registration atomically revokes that user's PIN-only sessions, while an exact configured HTTPS origin and recent registered-browser proof guard device mutations.

PIN login creates one unbound auth_sessions row per unbound user and revokes prior user rows; registered users create one bound row per credential, while programmer keeps one unbound single-session row.
Closing a shift always revokes that user's auth_sessions rows and evicts the token cache, regardless of who initiated the close.

Socket.IO connections carry the exact same identity guarantee as HTTP requests: both resolve through verifyToken/tokenCache, so a revoked token loses both simultaneously. Socket sessions expire by a per-socket deadline timeout, not by periodic validation.
audit_events rows for manager-override attempts are written even on failure/lockout, so every PIN attempt against a manager PIN is traceable.
The server may bind its port while startup status is starting, but all non-health HTTP requests and Socket.IO application work remain gated until migrations and validateRequiredSchema succeed.

DatabaseRuntime maintenance starts only after startup status is ready and stops when shutdown begins; command tracing remains active through the HTTP drain, then the runtime stops before pool.end(); business SQL is never retried and at most one background probe is owned.
A customer or staff Socket.IO connection is never routed to application handlers before io.use() authorization completes; the print agent uses authenticated HTTP sync only.
Uninstalling the POS server payload never stops or deletes the POSAppMariaDB service or ProgramData POSApp.
Startup self-repair may start or restart an existing owned service, but it never initializes, deletes, restores, or rewrites the database and never regenerates installer secrets.
The spooler process refuses to start in production without both CLOUD_SERVER_URL and SPOOLER_KEY set.
ENFORCE_HTTPS requires an explicit immediate TRUST_PROXY address or CIDR at startup; hosted deployments may not serve with forwarded protocol and client identity unresolved.
Release installers are only produced from a git-clean tree with vendor archives matching vendor-lock.json checksums.

The lightweight spooler bundle is only staging input: it must be built from a clean HEAD-matching installer stage, hydrate in ACL-protected ProgramData, and delegate final Program Files/service/config/registration ownership to Install-Spooler.ps1.

Spooler configuration maintenance must stop the exact managed service, capture the server heartbeat baseline, and require the expected agent heartbeat to advance after restart; identity rebind is explicit, refuses a non-empty local journal, and retires rather than deletes agent.json.

print_queue is append-only while delivery is unresolved: status moves forward through pending, processing, sent, acknowledged/failed/dead_letter/canceled, reprints are new rows, and only acknowledged rows created and settled before the current business day may be purged.
A print idempotency_key corresponds to at most one retained print_queue row; deleting an old acknowledged row deliberately expires queue-layer retry and reprint history for that key.

Only printers whose spooler_id equals the authenticated agent station may have their jobs claimed, and every current agent sends its configured spooler_id on sync so a retained credential cannot silently poll a different configured station.
A print_queue row assigned to an agent is never automatically reassigned; replacement terminalizes unresolved agent-owned work as outcome unknown.
An authenticated valid terminal result for an already-purged queue row is confirmable, but a missing acceptance-only record and an existing row owned by another agent are never confirmed.

A saved print-template revision becomes runtime-active globally for its document type when published; printer-test confirmations never gate activation or resolution, while missing, inactive, wrong-role, or endpoint-less printers still fail closed.

A V2 spooler process cannot read agent identity state until the Windows helper owns the machine mutex and the Node process atomically owns the canonical state-root lockfile via complete-private-file then exclusive hard-link; authorized starts quarantine malformed locks or tombstones and fail so the next start can acquire, live owners and live claimants stay fail-closed, and agent.json contains only a UUID and LocalMachine DPAPI ciphertext.

A V2 job is accepted to the server only after its complete local record is fsynced and atomically renamed; any restart after the durable transport-started marker reports outcome unknown and never makes that job runnable again.

One warm Typst compiler serves the serial kitchen-first render queue. Bounded image sections are rasterized in at most 256-row surfaces; physical endpoint transport lanes remain independent and only fresh authenticated sync health overwrites printer facts.

Typst is the sole document renderer and typst-only the sole installation target. Existing full profiles are recognized only as upgrade sources; browser dependencies, executable and fallback paths are absent. Hostinger emits saved print data/nativeLayout but never runs a renderer.

Typst supports receipt/kitchen nativeLayouts, compatible saved structured payloads, all report families and expense slips. A separate raw writer handles drawer pulses. Each compiled image is verified with a fresh render token; bounded sections become one atomically published artifact and one final cut. Invalid source fails before transport. The pinned compiler retains its hash-verified 5ms watch patch and Noto font payload.

Station health is authoritative only from a fresh authenticated last_sync_at; V2 health locks printer ownership through its guarded update, replaces the staff snapshot after commit, and admin reassignment or deletion clears the cached fact.

The V2 release gate must account for all mixed jobs with zero duplicate markers or submissions, prove another kitchen lane progresses during an offline printer, and keep physical USB/shared/TCP/write-only/paper-out/long-report/DPAPI/disk-full/interrupted-Windows evidence separate from automated proof.
A kitchen job whose transport may have started is forced to dead_letter and never auto-retried; only pre-transport failures use the bounded failed/next_retry_at path.
invoice_sequences.current_value (global_invoice) only increments, never resets, and is assigned to at most one invoice_id (unique index + ER_DUP_ENTRY collision handling).

Every new sale calculates and stores normal net subtotal, tax, and total; tax_inclusive_at_sale is an accounting compatibility flag, while receipt_tax_inclusive_at_sale freezes only the customer-copy display preference.
A split-check settle's server-recomputed totals must match the held payload's trustedSplitMoney within 1 cent per component, or checkout is rejected as a conflict.
Client-submitted subtotal/total are anti-tamper anchors only, tolerated within 2 cents (assertNearMoney) of the server's independently recomputed totals — they never drive persistence.

Fresh note-product surcharges are reconstructed from the current catalog and use the parent line's modifier-tax treatment. Note-category products cannot be fresh top-level lines: a cashier selection references noteProductId on an ordinary parent item, while an existing DB-declared nested bundle member remains a zero-priced child under the bundle canonicalizer.

An unavailable note product fails a fresh write with 409 NOTE_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE, but a held-order claim drops the dead selection and reprices instead. A deactivated base product still claims, so a stricter note rule would strand the hold: the browser recovery path only reaches a cart draft, which a hold that refuses to claim never becomes.
Saved table, split, and paid rows retain their frozen selected_modifiers, surcharge, and modifier tax even when the note catalog later changes.
A service charge (Auto-Gratuity) line requires either an explicit canApplyServiceCharge permission or a server-authorized snapshot — it can never be silently smuggled in.
A table settle's product line-up (excluding the Auto-Gratuity line) must match the saved order_items exactly in product/qty/note — no adds, removes or qty changes at checkout time.
The business day starts at 06:00 local (POS_BUSINESS_DAY_START_HOUR) and business SQL math is offset-first: CONVERT_TZ to local, then subtract the start-hour offset, never the reverse.

The shift-opening drawer context is current-business-day only and no-store: the previous closed shift actual_cash is both the reference and the editable suggested_starting_cash for the next sequential shift, suppressed while any shift is open; first_shift_starting_cash is the suggestion for every concurrent opening shift only until the first shift closes that business day. The server always persists the submitted starting_cash; a client dirty flag plus sequenced open/close, settings, reconnect and focus snapshots (POS) and a sequenced cashier-select/modal-open fetch (admin) prevent refreshes or older responses from overwriting typed input.
A jofotara_documents row stuck in status submitting for more than 2 minutes is forced to unknown and can never be silently retried; it requires manual review.
Printing a Y-held report and deleting the underlying held_orders happen in one DB transaction; the archived master_held row is the only way to recover a Y report after that print.

Per-user audit logging is suppressed by users.xyz set to 1 when that user would be either audit_events.user_id or audit_events.manager_id; appendAuditEvent and appendSecurityAuditEvent share this policy, so audit_events is intentionally incomplete for those users.

Table bill operations (void, refund, merge, split) and seating changes (join/disjoin) write their audit_events row inside the same DB transaction, before commit, subject to the existing users.xyz audit policy.
A table row's current_order_id and status can only be set to a non-available state while the whole joined-group is FOR UPDATE locked in one query with a consistent group_shape/invoice/status check.
A table order stays payment_method equal to unpaid_table until checkout finalizes it; every table-scoped mutation (save, split, void, transfer, merge, print) re-verifies this before writing.

For a tax-exempt sales-tax order, header and line tax are zero, an inclusive taxable product price is stripped exactly once, fixed modifier money is unchanged, and the exemption cannot silently change across a locked table, split-check, or platform-held lifecycle.

POS order-session localStorage is cleared only after a confirmed successful shift close and before reload; failed close responses preserve the draft, while saved-table money/tax/cart remains server-authoritative and unsaved-table drafts require an exact version-2 order identity match.

Recipe ledger writes stay in the caller's transaction. RecipeLedgerService never commits and never emits. Callers emit ingredients_changed after commit when changedIngredientIds is non-empty. Ledger code never reads or writes products.stock, stock_enabled, stock_deducted, or refunds.restocked, and shortage never rejects a sale.

A platform remittance reversal copies every allocation with its original sign and applies reversal direction only at query time; provider payouts remain outside sales, cash/card totals, shifts, X/Z, tax, stock and JoFotara.

A call_center session always has zero grants and no section/shift authority; checkout, payment, refund, expense, service-charge, manual print, table, manager-override and admin routes reject the role. The allowed held-order lifecycle may trigger server-owned automatic kitchen dispatch for a validated unscheduled phone hold, but the actor cannot select a printer or invoke the manual fire route. Phone-source attribution is written by the server on held creation and copied to orders only from the locked held row during cashier checkout.

The versioned external order-intake API is disabled by default and authenticates one configured client with a hashed Bearer key plus a dedicated active call_center actor. It rejects caller-owned money, tax, discount, payment, table and print fields; re-prices before signing and again before insert; requires an unchanged unexpired quote plus explicit confirmation; and can only create a kitchen_fired=0 held order for cashier review. Durable non-PII request results prevent a delayed retry from recreating an order after its held row is consumed or canceled.

Only a valid normalized delivery date suppresses automatic held-order kitchen dispatch; cashier-entered reference text never selects hold kind, and true table splits are created with server-owned parent/table lineage by the table module.

tax_inclusive_pricing is read only when a new sale/hold is created to freeze receipt_tax_inclusive_at_sale or receipt_tax_inclusive_at_hold; receipt renderers use that snapshot to format gross customer rows and hide subtotal/tax without changing stored accounting money.

The database queued-acquisition timeout starts only after mysql2 enqueues a waiter: connection establishment remains bounded by connectTimeout, running SQL is untouched, and a connection delivered after queue timeout is released without running the abandoned operation.

Mysql2 command disconnects are observed through its query/execute tracing error channels without retaining SQL or bound values; each trace context is counted once, diagnostics never retry business SQL, and command failures remain distinct from unsolicited leased-socket errors.

Every executeCheckout call finalizes an order and requires an eligible actor plus an open shift for ordinary staff; a submitted payment_method, edit_order_id, or manager PIN cannot bypass checkout authority.

A fresh direct order-type checkout carries the terminal's boolean deferred-settlement snapshot, but the active database row remains money authority: a missing or mismatched snapshot fails with 409 before persistence, and deferred orders are server-stamped as zero-tender platform sales. Locked table, split, platform-held, and ordinary-held contexts retain their server-owned historical classification.

Starting, expected, and actual cash are per-shift snapshots. Reports may aggregate movements, counts, shortages, overages, and signed variance, but never drawer balances. A closed shift's expected_cash is frozen at close. Admin/programmer update_cash moves it by the starting_cash delta with an audit event; expense cancellation adds back the canceled drawer amount in the same transaction as status/canceled_by/canceled_at. Neither path recomputes it from orders or changes actual_cash. An actual_cash correction changes only the count and variance. Variance hints (starting_cash_mismatch, count_excluded_opening) and drawer_change_since_previous_close are derived in integer cents from neighbouring shifts at read time and never stored.

recipe_line_key is the sold-line identity for the optional recipe ledger. Frozen quantities and costs live in ingredient rows of stock_movements; recipe_ledger_lines stores immutable ingredient IDs, including an empty array, for current lock discovery. Feature off writes no usage or new line records and leaves new keys NULL; reversals still run for existing keys.

Selected table item transfers preserve saved line prices, rates, discounts, modifiers, bundle children and stock snapshots. Partial prepared lines receive independent recipe keys using paired recorded-cost allocation entries. Combined payable cents must remain exact; each still-open bill rounds its own net/tax components. Order-wide discounts or incompatible tax/service-charge profiles fail closed except pure whole-bill relocation to an empty table.

Permission keys, roles, presets and bilingual examples have one catalog source; the pure shared permissionPolicy composes action requirements without database or network work. Employee edits lock and compare an edit_version before changing grants and revoking sessions.

nodes.label: Admin / Manager
nodes.sub: role admin or programmer; holds the PIN

nodes.label: Cashier
nodes.sub: logs in with a user_number at a terminal

nodes.label: Call-center worker
nodes.sub: fixed zero-permission role; no shift or checkout authority

nodes.label: External order assistant
nodes.sub: provider-neutral model or deterministic gateway using one scoped Bearer credential

nodes.label: Customer
nodes.sub: pays, receives a receipt

nodes.label: Spooler service
nodes.sub: Windows service using one authenticated V2 HTTP sync request at a time with an agent-minted secret

nodes.label: Technician
nodes.sub: Runs installers, repairs, uninstalls, and nightly ops

nodes.label: Inventory Page
nodes.sub: products and categories, Stock levels, Purchase invoices (products only, item-kind product; shown when product stock is on) and Stock counts tabs (lazy; counts shown when stock or the recipe ledger is on), opened from ?tab=purchases|counts; low-stock filter driven by low_stock_threshold; live inventory_changed listener

nodes.label: Catalog import dialog
nodes.sub: retains original File for upload; latest inspection wins; cancels work on file replacement, removal and unmount

nodes.label: On-demand workbook worker
nodes.sub: SheetJS is isolated from Inventory entry and UI thread; transfers inspection metadata or template bytes and terminates after each task

nodes.label: Admin realtime bridge
nodes.sub: one authenticated shell-owned Socket.IO client forwards compatibility events including ingredients_changed and aggregate reconciliation hints after bootstrap

nodes.label: Admin stock alert reconciliation
nodes.sub: event-first low-stock alerts refreshed by inventory_changed, ingredients_changed, settings and reconnect signals plus focus/visible recovery; no timer

nodes.label: Admin print queue reconciliation
nodes.sub: aggregate queue, enqueue, station and printer-status signals trigger a rate-bounded authoritative health read, with a 30 s fallback refresh while the view is open; explicit actions force an immediate refresh

nodes.label: Product Modal
nodes.sub: gross-price entry + modifier group/option editor + bundle editor trigger + optional Recipe tab when recipe_ledger_enabled

nodes.label: Settings Page
nodes.sub: toggles the tax-inclusive customer-receipt display preference, tables, service charge, and recipe_ledger_enabled; invalidates client settings cache after save

nodes.label: DeviceAccessSettings.vue
nodes.sub: dedicated settings tab for bootstrap, enrollment, replacement, and revocation; shows auto-detected pending browsers plus per-user bound/PIN-only state and desktop enrollment links, while only the hidden programmer controls the global switch

nodes.label: Users Page
nodes.sub: Role presets, explicit all/selected/none table scope, effective action preview, stale-edit conflict and explicit recovery of uncertain saves.

nodes.label: Login.vue

No per-item activation; gated by stock_enabled and recipe_ledger_enabled. Bounded search (with starts_tracking) where a barcode or the typed text matches a product's main or extra barcode exactly and every product row carries matched_barcode (the code that matched, else null), and groups; resolveForUpdate validates eligibility for the use and locks products, links, ingredients, stock_items and balances in the sale path order with IN lists, returning current quantities.

nodes.label: StockDocumentPosting.js

Reversal puts a product it started tracking back to unlimited (NULL) while that version is unchanged, otherwise subtracts; it refuses to take simple stock below zero or to undo a receipt whose linked stock item changed; count():linked-product ledger counts, one simple-stock update with journal row, and ingredient count batches.

ordered shutdown stops runtime, monitor, renderer, and helper before releasing the owned lockfile

confirmed accepts/results and cancellations are applied before each returned job is atomically accepted locally
a transport-started record recovers as uncertain after restart and cannot re-enter the runnable set

revoked or decommissioned status is persisted before workers remain paused; draining advertises zero new capacity but still finishes owned work
a newly durable terminal result requests a prompt sync; repeated notifications coalesce and active backoff remains authoritative

nonce-verified bounded Typst sections are encoded into 256-row raster bands, fsynced and atomically renamed as one hash-addressed artifact
each normalized transport endpoint owns one serial lane across printer-record aliases while independent devices may transport concurrently
safe transient failures retry with foreground/background caps; uncertain outcomes become terminal outbox records and hold later jobs at that endpoint across restart
a journal write failure is retried only after its own deadline, independent of faster sync or worker wake cadence

flows.summary: A per-printer lane verifies the artifact again immediately before the transport marker, then either streams bounded TCP bytes or asks the single Windows helper to submit the same file; the existing result carries bounded stage timing without another request or write, and post-marker failure is never safely retried.
